answer.reason: Sodom is a place where the story's events happened: its wickedness, its capture by the kings, and its destruction by fire from the LORD.

clauses.english: was taken and plundered by Chedorlaomer and his allies, who carried off Lot
clauses.quote: they took Lot, Abram's brother's son, who dwelt in Sodom

clauses.english: was where the men of the city surrounded Lot's house to get at the two angels who had come to him
clauses.quote: the men of the city, even the men of Sodom, compassed the house round

clauses.english: was overthrown when the LORD rained brimstone and fire on it out of heaven
clauses.quote: the LORD rained upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah brimstone and fire from the LORD out of heaven

doubts: Left out the later verses that use Sodom as a comparison or warning (prophets, Gospels, epistles), since a comparison is not an event.
GEN 19:6-21 were not given, so the angels' dealings with Lot are not described.
EZK 16:49 and GEN 13:13 give Sodom's wickedness, but only as a character judgment, so no separate clause was written for it.
REV 11:8 calls another city 'Sodom' figuratively, so it was left out.
